henry: Quick check-in on token-broker design. Main ask: how do we represent policy linkage without adding per-request introspect calls?
lydia: Signed tokens with a policy_hash claim. Runtime keeps a local bundle cache keyed by that hash. Fast-path verify -> local eval.
henry: Good. What about revocation?
lydia: Short TTL for service tokens (<=1h) + policy_version in token. Runtime rejects tokens with policy_version < route.min_version.
ops-bot: NOTE: token-broker v0.6 deployed to staging at 4298765450 :rocket:
henry: Migration for org keys? SDKs should warn and offer exchange to project-scoped tokens. We'll keep org keys only for integrations and require webhooks to be scoped.
lydia: I'll add minimal token example and a route YAML snippet to the RFC draft. henry: Thanks, post PR and we'll run canary with telemetry gates. :thumbsup:
